text: This report seeks approval from the Board for adjustments to project commitments required to deliver the approved 2025-2034 Toronto Zoo Capital Plan and Budget. The 2025-2034 Capital Plan and Budget was approved by the Board at its meeting on October 2, 2024 and by Toronto City Council on February 11, 2025.

In accordance with the approved 2025-2034 Toronto Zoo Capital Plan and Budget, the Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the following project commitment adjustments for the Community Conservation Centre (Welcome Area) project: a. an increase in total construction costs to be tendered under the construction management contract with PCL from $61.0 million to $75.0 million, excluding applicable taxes; and b. an increase in the design contract value with Zeidler Architect from $2,522,123.89 to $3,443,559.80 including all fees and disbursements, excluding applicable taxes. 2.
